Campus in a rack (senior project, 2025 - 2026)
- Built a three-building campus network on six real Cisco 2960 and 3560 switches and three ISR routers borrowed from the department lab, configuring all of them from the console.
- Kept students, staff and security cameras in separate broadcast domains that can reach each other only through the distribution layer.
- Carved a single /22 into right-sized blocks for 11 departments and recorded every allocation.
- Ran a link-state routing protocol in a single backbone area between the three routers, and checked that traffic found a new path in under 10 seconds when I unplugged a link.
- Drew the topology and wrote a port-by-port cabling sheet that the lab still uses.

Guest Wi-Fi for the college open day (2025)

Why is Lab 3 slow? (2025)
- Captured traffic on the lab uplink, found one PC flooding the segment with broadcast frames from a faulty network card, and shut its port until the card was replaced.
